## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

✅ **Gate recommendation: approve.**

Switching to the already-supported multilingual v3 model is a focused fix for the retired default. The existing adapter supplies the required document and query input types.

Please mark this PR with the `breaking-change` label.

**Documentation:** Update Cohere’s default in the [embedding overview](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/blob/ffc37539be6d6c1f9ae36c04f5e210e19c89bbcb/docs/web/embedding/index.mdx#L184) to `embed-multilingual-v3.0`. In the [Cohere guide](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/blob/ffc37539be6d6c1f9ae36c04f5e210e19c89bbcb/docs/web/integrations/embedding/cohere.mdx#L22), mention the change from 768 to 1,024 dimensions and that existing v2 vectors need re-embedding into a matching schema.

✅ **Gate recommendation: approve.**

Multilingual v3 is a supported replacement for the retired default, and the adapter already supplies its document/query input types. The overview and Cohere documentation now consistently describe the default and the required migration from 768 to 1,024 dimensions.
